## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss potential collaboration between Levi Woods and MindTrajour on enhancing their options trading journal app.](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=0.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Levi's complex trading strategies require more advanced features than MindTrajour's current MVP](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=2.0)
  - [Key needs: multi-leg trade grouping, individual leg closing, and real-time options data (challenging due to cost)](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=10.0)
  - [Both parties interested in potential collaboration, but more development needed before Levi can fully test the app](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)
  - [Agreement to reconnect in 1-2 months after MindTrajour implements some suggested improvements](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1480.0)

## Topics

### Current MindTrajour App Features

  - [Simple UI with two-leg option trades](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=3.0)
  - [Manual data entry for trades](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=6.0)
  - [Basic profit/loss tracking](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=15.0)
  - [Recently added share functionality for read-only trade viewing](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1276.0)
  - [Emotion tracking and trade checklists](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1276.0)

### Levi's Trading Approach and Needs

  - [Uses complex multi-leg strategies (up to 14-16 legs typically, some up to 168)](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=440.0)
  - [Tracks trades using custom spreadsheets with trade reference numbers](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=413.0)
  - [Needs ability to group related trades and close individual legs](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1098.0)
  - [Requires real-time options data for accurate P\&L tracking (currently unavailable in MindTrajour)](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1306.0)

### Potential App Improvements

  - [Add trade reference field to link related trades](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1098.0)
  - [Implement ability to add multiple legs to a single trade](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1098.0)
  - [Create a simplified trade entry system with 8 core action types](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1098.0)
  - [Consider advanced mode or higher-tier subscription for complex features](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1098.0)
  - [Explore options for integrating real-time options data (challenging due to high costs)](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1306.0)

### Collaboration Discussion

  - [Levi open to testing improved version and providing feedback](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1440.0)
  - [Potential for future deeper involvement, pending app enhancements](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1440.0)
  - [No formal commitments made; agreement to reconnect in 1-2 months](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1480.0)

### MindTrajour Business Context

  - [Small team of 4, bootstrapped with no outside investment](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1519.0)
  - [Currently have 30-40 active users](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1534.0)
  - [Focusing on MVP approach after scrapping overly complex previous version](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)

## Next Steps

  - [MindTrajour to work on implementing trade reference field and multi-leg functionality](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
  - [Explore options for real-time data integration, considering cost constraints](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
  - [Levi to test updated app version once core improvements are made](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
  - [Reconnect in 1-2 months to discuss progress and potential next steps for collaboration](https://fathom.video/share/RoW_5FPDQwRskyoKUL6AHshmX2Vwiniz?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
